verses.en: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, What have I done? what is mine iniquity? and what is my sin before thy father, that he seeketh my life?
verses.sm: Tavita nai Naiota i Rama, ua alu ma fai atu i luma o Ionatana, Se a le mea ua ou faia? o le a foi laʻu agasala, po o le a loʻu sese i luma o lou tama, ina ua ia saili e fasioti ia te au?

verses.en: And he said unto him, God forbid; thou shalt not die: behold, my father will do nothing either great or small, but that he will shew it me: and why should my father hide this thing from me? it is not so.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o ia ia te ia, Ia mamao lava lea; e te le oti lava; faauta, e le faia e lo'u tama se mea tele po o se mea itiiti, a e muai taʻu mai i oku taliga; e nana ea i se a e loʻu tama lenei mea ia te au? E le o faapea lava.

verses.en: And David sware moreover, and said, Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly as the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, there is but a step between me and death.
verses.sm: A ua tauto lava Tavita, ua fai atu, Ua iloa lava e lou tamà ua alofagia aʻu e oe, ua faapea ane o ia, Aua ne“ iloa le mea nei e Ionatana, ne‘i tiga ai o ia; o loo soifua le ALII, ua e soifua foi oe, e moni lava, ua peiseai o le laasaga e tasi i le va o aʻu ma le on.

verses.en: Then said Jonathan unto David, Whatsoever thy soul desireth, I will even do it for thee.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o Ionatana ia Tavita, O se mea e te manao i ai, ou te faia lava lea mo oe.

verses.en: And David said unto Jonathan, Behold, to morrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat: but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field unto the third day at even.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu Tavita ia Ionatana, Faauta, a taeao o le masina faatoa vaaia, e tatau ai ona ma nonofo faatasi ma le tupu, ma te aai ma ia; tuu mai ia o aʻu, ou te lafi foi i le vao seia oo i le afiafi i e luā;

verses.en: If thy father at all miss me, then say, David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Beth-lehem his city: for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the family.
verses.sm: afai e fesili lou tama ia te au, e te fai atu, Na faanoi mai lava Tavita ia te au, ia momo'e atu o ia i Peteleema lona nuu, aua e i ai le taulaga e fai i tausaga mo lona aiga uma.

verses.en: If he say thus, It is well; thy servant shall have peace: but if he be very wroth, then be sure that evil is determined by him.
verses.sm: Afai e faapea mai o ia, Ua lelei; o le manuia lea o lau auauna; a e afai e matuá toasa o ia, ona e iloa lea ua finagalo vale mai o ia.

verses.en: Therefore thou shalt deal kindly with thy servant; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of the LORD with thee: notwithstanding, if there be in me iniquity, slay me thyself; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father?
verses.sm: E te alofa foi i lau auauna, aua o le feagaiga a le ALII na e faia ma lau auauna; a e afai o i ai se agasala ia te au, ia e fasioti lava oe ia te au; se a le mea e te avatu ai aʻu i lou tama?

verses.en: And Jonathan said, Far be it from thee: for if I knew certainly that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee, then would not I tell it thee?
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o Ionatana, Ia mamao ia te oe; aua ana ou iloa lava ua iu le filifiliga a loʻu tama, o le a oo se leaga ia te oe, po ua ou taʻu atu ia te oe.

verses.en: Then said David to Jonathan, Who shall tell me? or what if thy father answer thee roughly?
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Tavita ia Ionatana, O ai ea e taʻu mai ia te au pe afai e tali mai lou tama ia te oe ma le ita?

verses.en: And Jonathan said unto David, Come, and let us go out into the field. And they went out both of them into the field.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai Ionatana ia Tavita, Sau ia, ina ta o atu i le vao; ona o lea o i laua i le yao.

verses.en: And Jonathan said unto David, O LORD God of Israel, when I have sounded my father about to morrow any time, or the third day, and, behold, if there be good toward David, and I then send not unto thee, and shew it thee;
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o Ionatana ia Tavita, le ALri le Atua o Isaraelu, ia sisila mai o ia, a uma ona ou tofotofo i loʻu tama e faapenei le aso taeao po o è luā; faauta foi, afai e loto lelei o ia ia Tavita, afai ou te le auina atu se tasi ia te Oe e ta'u atu ai ia te oe,

verses.en: The LORD do so and much more to Jonathan: but if it please my father to do thee evil, then I will shew it thee, and send thee away, that thou mayest go in peace: and the LORD be with thee, as he hath been with my father.
verses.sm: ia faapea ona faia e le ALII ia Ionatana, ma ia faaopoopo i ai; a e afai e loto loʻu tama e agaleaga ia te oe, ou te tau atu lava ia te oe, ma tuuina atu ia te oe ia alu ma le filemu; ia ia te oe foi le ALII, e pei ona sa i ai i loʻu tama.

verses.en: And thou shalt not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of the LORD, that I die not:
verses.sm: Afai ou te ola pea aʻu, ia e faia le alofa o le ALII ia te au, ia a‘u le oti; a e afai ou te oti,

verses.en: But also thou shalt not cut off thy kindness from my house for ever: no, not when the LORD hath cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth.
verses.sm: aua le tuua foi lou alofa i loʻu aiga e faavavau, pe a faaumatia e le ALII nai le fogáeleele taitasi uma o e ita ia Tavita.

verses.en: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, Let the LORD even require it at the hand of David's enemies.
verses.sm: Ua osi ai le feagaiga a Ionatana ma le aiga o Tavita, ua faapea, ia suea e le ALII ai lima o e ita ia Tavita.

verses.en: And Jonathan caused David to swear again, because he loved him: for he loved him as he loved his own soul.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu Ionatana, ia toe tauto Tavita ina ua alofa o ia ia te ia; aua ua ia alofa ia te ia, pei o lona alofa ia te ia lava.

verses.en: Then Jonathan said to David, To morrow is the new moon: and thou shalt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai Ionatana ia te ia, O le masina faatoa vaaia taeao, e silia ai Oe, auà e le nofoia lou nofoa.

verses.en: And when thou hast stayed three days, then thou shalt go down quickly, and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself when the business was in hand, and shalt remain by the stone Ezel.
verses.sm: A tolu ni ou aso, ona e alu ifo loa lea, ma alu atu i le mea na e lafi ai i le aso na fai ai le mea, ma e nofo e latalata ane i le maa o Asela.

verses.en: And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof, as though I shot at a mark.
verses.sm: O aʻu foi, ou te fana ni ue tolu i le tasi ona itu, e peiseai ou te fana atu ai i se manulauti.

verses.en: And, behold, I will send a lad, saying, Go, find out the arrows. If I expressly say unto the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of thee, take them; then come thou: for there is peace to thee, and no hurt; as the LORD liveth.
verses.sm: Faauta .foi, ou te auina atu se tama e alu ma saili i u; afai ou te matuā fai atu i le tama, Faauta, o uo loo i ou tala mai, ia e tago i ai; ona e Sau ai lea, awa o le a manuia oe, ua leai lava se mea; ua soifua le ALII.

verses.en: But if I say thus unto the young man, Behold, the arrows are beyond thee; go thy way: for the LORD hath sent thee away.
verses.sm: A e afai ou te fai atu faapea i le taulealea, Faauta o u o loo i ou tala atu; alu ia oe, aua ua auina atu oe e le ALII.

verses.en: And as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of, behold, the LORD be between thee and me for ever.
verses.sm: Ao le mea na ta tautala ai, o atu ma oe, faauta, o le ALII e va a“ taua, o oe ma aʻu e faavavau.

verses.en: So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come, the king sat him down to eat meat.
verses.sm: Ua lafi Tavita i le vao; ua oo foi i le masina faatoa vaaia, ona nofo ai lea o le tupu e fai le taumafataga.

verses.en: And the king sat upon his seat, as at other times, even upon a seat by the wall: and Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul's side, and David's place was empty.
verses.sm: Ua nofo le tupu i lona nofoa, pei o isi aso, i le nofoa i tala ane o le pa o le fale; ua tulai Ionatana, a ua nofo Apineru i tafatafa o Saulo; ua le nofoia foi le nofoa o Tavita.

verses.en: Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day: for he thought, Something hath befallen him, he is not clean; surely he is not clean.
verses.sm: A ua le fai mai e Saulo se upu i lea aso, aua ua ia faapea, Ua oo se mea ia te ia, ua le mama o ia, ai lava e le mama o ia.

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, which was the second day of the month, that David's place was empty: and Saul said unto Jonathan his son, Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat, neither yesterday, nor to day?
verses.sm: Ua oo i le taeao, (o le aso lua lea o le masina,) ua le nofoia foi le nofoa o Tavita; ona fai mai lea o Saulo ia Ionatana Jona atalii, Po o le a le mea e le sau ai le atalii 0 Iese, ananafi atoa ma le asó e “ai ai?

verses.en: And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Beth-lehem:
verses.sm: Ona tali atu ai lea o Ionatana ia Saulo, Na faanoi mai lava Tavita, ia alu o ia i Peteleema;

verses.en: And he said, Let me go, I pray thee; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city; and my brother, he hath commanded me to be there: and now, if I have found favour in thine eyes, let me get away, I pray thee, and see my brethren. Therefore he cometh not unto the king's table.
verses.sm: ua fai mai, Ia e tuu mai aʻu, ou te alu; aua o le taulaga e fai i lo matou aiga i le aai; ua poloai mai foi loʻu uso ia te au; o lenei, afai e te alofa mai ia te au, tuu mai ia o au ia matou feiloai ma oʻu uso; o le mea lea ua le sau ai o ia i le laoai a le tupu.

verses.en: Then Saul's anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said unto him, Thou son of the perverse rebellious woman, do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own confusion, and unto the confusion of thy mother's nakedness?
verses.sm: Ona ita ai lea 0 Saulo ia Ionatana, ua fai mai ia te ia, Le tama a le fafine amio piopio ma le finau vale! ou te lei iloa ea ua e filifilia le atalii o Iese i lou faamaina, ma le faamaina o le le lavalava o lou tina?

verses.en: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground, thou shalt not be established, nor thy kingdom. Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me, for he shall surely die.
verses.sm: Aua o aso uma e ola ai le atalii o Iese i le fogaeleele e le faatumauina oe ma lou malo; o lenei, ia e aami atu ia te ia, ma au mai ia te au, anae on lava ia.

verses.en: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him, Wherefore shall he be slain? what hath he done?
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea O Ionatana ia Saulo lona tama, ua faapea atu ja te ia, E ou i se a? Se a se mea ua faia e ia;

verses.en: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him: whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David.
verses.sm: Ona velo ai lea e Saulo le tao ia te ia e fasi ai ia te ia; Ona iloa ai lea e Ionatana, ua tonu i lona tama ia fasiotia lava Tavita.

verses.en: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no meat the second day of the month: for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.
verses.sm: Ona tulai lea o Ionatana nai le laoai ma le ita tele, ua le ‘ai se mea i le aso e lua o le masina, aua ua tiga ona O Tavita, ina ua faaleagaina o ia e lona tama.

verses.en: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.
verses.sm: Ua 00 i le taeao, ona o atu lea o Ionatana o i laua ma le tama itiiti, i le vao i le itula na la tuuina ma Tavita.

verses.en: And he said unto his lad, Run, find out now the arrows which I shoot. And as the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.
verses.sm: Ua ia fai atu i lana auauna, Momo'e atu, ina saili u ou te fana atu. Ua momo'e le tama, ona fana atu lea le u i ona tala atu.

verses.en: And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad, and said, Is not the arrow beyond thee?
verses.sm: Ua oo atu le tama i le mea ua i ai le u na fana atu e Ionatana, Ona valaau atu lea e lonatana i le tama, ua faapea, E le ua i ou tala atu ea le u?

verses.en: And Jonathan cried after the lad, Make speed, haste, stay not. And Jonathan's lad gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.
verses.sm: Ona valaau atu lea o lonatana i le tama, la tele vave lava, aua neʻi tu. Ua ao u e le tama na 6 ma lonatana, ona au mai lea i lona alii.

verses.en: But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.
verses.sm: Ua le iloa e le tama le mea, na o lonatana ma Tavita ua la iloa le mea.

verses.en: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad, and said unto him, Go, carry them to the city.
verses.sm: Ona tuu atu lea e Ionatana o ana auupega i le tama sa ia te ia, ua fai atu ia te ia, Alu ia, ina avatu nei mea i le aai.

verses.en: And as soon as the lad was gone, David arose out of a place toward the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times: and they kissed one another, and wept one with another, until David exceeded.
verses.sm: Ua alu le tama, ona tulai lea o Tavita nai le itu i toga, ua faapaú fao i le eleele, ua ifo faatolu, ua feasogi foi i laua, ma fetagisi i laua, ua 00 ina faasili Tavita.

verses.en: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the LORD, saying, The LORD be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o lonatana ia Tavita, Alu ia ma le manuia, aua ua tauto i taua ma aʻu ile suafa o le ALII, ua faapea, Ia i aile ALn i le va o aʻu ma oe, i le va foi o laʻu fanau ma lau fanau e faavavau. Ona tulai lea o ia, ma alu ese, a e alu lonatana i le aai.
